title: Model Instruments for Data Center Development in Florida Counties
gaps: Known gaps: no county has adopted these instruments, no licensed attorney has reviewed them, and none of the studies they depend on has been done.

records.label: Record 1: Instruments
records.contents: The model ordinances, agreements, modules and forms, the impact study outline, and the Drafter's Notes

notes.text: You may adopt, adapt, excerpt and codify this material without attribution and without permission.
If these instruments inform an adopted ordinance or executed agreement, a citation to the deposit DOI helps others trace provenance and locate errata.

records.label: Record 2: Guide, Open Legal Questions and Methodology
records.contents: A plain-language guide, the open legal questions, and two tests for deciding what belongs in a county instrument

instruments.name: Model Data Center Standards Ordinance, with Exhibit A, Data Center Standards
instruments.about: Adopting ordinance and Exhibit A, Data Center Standards: tiers and applications, siting, screening and lighting, water and cooling, water withdrawal and wells, sound, generators, stormwater, karst and flood, burials and archaeological resources, hazardous systems, equipment stewardship, decommissioning, review, monitoring and enforcement

instruments.name: Data Center Technical Manual (Exhibit B to the Standards Ordinance)
instruments.about: Exhibit B to the Standards Ordinance: methods, submittals, tests and report formats

instruments.name: Module M1, Conditional Use Review
instruments.about: Optional conditional use review procedure (Sec. 15A of the Standards)

instruments.name: County Procedure and Records Kit
instruments.about: Staff report, Sec. 15A insert, resolution, business impact estimate, hearing calendar, gap check, and a plan policy on data center water sources

instruments.name: Model Data Center Public Safety and Emergency Power Impact Fee Ordinance
instruments.about: Impact fee for fire rescue and hazardous materials facilities and, where the technical study finds need and benefit, emergency medical services and emergency power at County facilities

instruments.name: Model Host Community Development Agreement
instruments.about: Host Community Development Agreement under ss. 163.3220 to 163.3243, Florida Statutes, for mitigation of impacts the County's study measures

instruments.name: Model Host Community Development Agreement: Exhibits and Forms
instruments.about: The agreement's exhibits, and forms of utility cost affidavit, letters of credit, emergency equipment lease, decommissioning security, and commitment status table and completion statement

instruments.name: Schedule of Supplemental Operating Covenants (Exhibit "S")
instruments.about: Exhibit "S": operating covenants beyond the Standards, for the agreement or a County ground lease

instruments.name: Module M2, Emergency Power for County Facilities
instruments.about: Optional: emergency power capability at County facilities

instruments.name: Exhibit "B-1" Outline and Methodology
instruments.about: Outline and method for the County's own Exhibit "B-1" impact, nexus and proportionality findings

instruments.name: Model Ground Lease
instruments.about: Ground lease of County land for a data center, with the County as landlord

instruments.name: Module M3, Civic Compute Allocation
instruments.about: Optional: computing capacity as part of lease rent (Part 2) or under the private agreement (Part 3)

instruments.name: Module M3 Options
instruments.about: Optional provisions of Module M3 (a County computing share, an Instruction Share, open hardware obtained through the developer, and first refusal on retired equipment), each inserted at its number when chosen

instruments.name: Model Community Benefits Agreement
instruments.about: Private agreement between the developer and a community organization. The County is not a party

instruments.name: Community Benefits Agreement Clause Bank
instruments.about: Optional terms for the private agreement, and the terms not yet drafted

instruments.name: Drafter's Notes
instruments.about: By instrument and section: each blank, what sets it, and the statute that requires the provision
instruments.quote: by instrument and section: each blank, what sets it, and the statute that requires the provision

guide.name: Plain Language Guide
guide.about: The instruments in plain English, for residents, commissioners and county staff

guide.name: Open Legal Questions
guide.about: For each legal question the instruments raise, the answer the primary sources support and how firm it is, the change it calls for, and the narrower question left for counsel or an agency. Nothing in this record is a legal review

guide.name: In-Kind Eligibility and Characterization Test
guide.about: Where a proposed item belongs: in a standard, a fee, a development agreement, a lease or a private agreement, or nowhere

guide.name: Consideration Adequacy and Fit Test
guide.about: For a County ground lease or a private agreement only: whether what is received is adequate and fits the need
